title: Asterix - The Twelve Tasks of Asterix - #8: Find Permit A 38 in "The Place That Sends You Mad"
summary: A segment from the animated film The Twelve Tasks of Asterix, in which Asterix must get Permit A 38 from a maze-like building run by unhelpful bureaucrats. He wins by asking for a nonexistent permit.
why: HN commenters reference it as the famous satire of bureaucracy, including as the name for an SSH key management tool.

quote.text: Permit A38 references a scene from an Asterix and Obelix animated film
